subject: general
question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

NLJ, JHF, FDB, BZX, ?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b23ceadf778314ff09521881a76bfa4a655ab23a97a31e4dc298ba517b84ed2.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d532cfeabbccaa003d43cde0b2eda26279e0adb48b9f972f9c7a4c6f66b1682.png] 

So, "**XVT" **will replace the question mark (?) in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
